definitions.sameNativeBodyInput: Exact pos, vel, facing, stance, support and energy at controller start; new frame/plan metadata is compared separately.
definitions.phaseChange: A different desired phase with identical native body, read creation time and consumed image. Free-travel estimate differences alone are not physical changes.
definitions.nativeUnits: Force kg*yd/s^2, impulse kg*yd/s and work kg*yd^2/s^2. Multiply force/impulse by .9144 for N/N*s and work by .9144^2 for J. Saved fields remain native.
definitions.fall: Native lastStep reports a fall, with actual contacts, impulse/work budgets and pre/next support states retained. It is not inferred from a phase label.

limits: Native first-frame intervention supports a mechanism, not a one-factor ablation proving causal exclusivity.
These panels change both legacy-frame preservation and the support-scaled free-travel heuristic. Changed endpoints have no observed phase switch on identical native inputs before a frame change.
Native support and collision consequence can be physically coherent while the runner/controller choice that creates the contact remains poor football.
Every comparison uses saved observations; no new perception, RNG, plays or forced finishes.
